_meta.name: Checkpoint (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Pony / Illustrious)
_meta.description: Classic single-checkpoint text-to-image. Works with any SD 1.5, SDXL, Pony or Illustrious .safetensors in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. The Model dropdown lists what ComfyUI sees in that folder.
notes: This is ComfyUI's default graph exported in API format with the user-controlled values replaced by {{TOKENS}}.
To use a different checkpoint: just pick it in the Model dropdown (it fills {{MODEL}}).

To add a LoRA: insert a LoraLoader node between 4 (checkpoint) and the KSampler/CLIPTextEncode nodes in ComfyUI, export (API) again, copy this _meta block in, save as a new file in this folder, restart Darkroom.
Size presets: SD 1.5 likes 512x512 / 512x768; SDXL, Pony and Illustrious like 1024x1024, 832x1216, 1216x832.
Sampler tips: dpmpp_2m + karras is a safe default; Pony/Illustrious often look best with euler_ancestral + normal.
requires: ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/<any SD1.5, SDXL, Pony or Illustrious checkpoint>.safetensors

defaults.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, blurry
